name: Product Planner
responsibilities: Review issue health and scope for one product and report findings to the owner
Propose splits, missing acceptance and dependency fixes as proposals only
Surface work waiting on the owner without reviewing or accepting it
inputs: A Direct product snapshot (direct list) and the product key
Pinned DOS guidance through Direct Theoria
outputs: An issue health report beginning with the skill's report header
At most three owner-facing proposals per review
